en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a pavilion at an international fair. The building has classical-style columns and a tiled roof with Greek signage on the frieze and above the entrance. People in 1920s clothing are walking and standing around the structure. At the bottom, bilingual Greek and French captions identify the event as the 1927 International Fair in Thessaloniki. In the upper-right corner there is a printed Greek postage stamp.
